title: Request-target validation checks the path but not the query, allowing CRLF header injection
source: Real-world defect (reconstruction): CPython http.client request-target handling pre-fix for CVE-2019-9740 (CRLF injection via the query string of a URL passed to urllib.request.urlopen), bpo-36276, fixed upstream by CPython PR GH-12755 (first released in 3.7.4); the defective validation is reconstructed standalone in this case, 2026-11-05. Substituted for the brief's CVE-2020-8492, which on verification is a ReDoS (bpo-39503), not the described CRLF defect
